line: A friend of the courier's sent us. You tasted the sap. You are hurt.
The hurt go by boat to a house in Lilmoth. That means you.
A friend of the courier's sent us. You have tasted the sap and you are hurt. I am sorry for it.
The hurt go by boat to a house in Lilmoth. You are one of them. You are welcome aboard.
A friend of the courier's sent us. You are hurt, as the others are.
The hurt go by boat to a house in Lilmoth.
The shed is beside the withdrawn cutting, at the camp's far end. Sap lies spilled on its floor.
Burnt boards lie over deep water at the camp's fire.
The courier's strap and tag lie in the gang families' locked fish-trap. It is on the bottom, straight below the boards.
Lockpicks lie loose beside the fire. I do not know you well. That is all I give.
